positions.description: Working on Azure Arc Data Services in the Azure Data organization

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on Azure Arc Data services in the Azure Data organization

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: • Working under Professor Adam Cannon as a Teaching Assistant for course W1004 (Intro to CS in Java).

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description: • Working under Professor David Vallancourt as a Lab Assistant for course E1201 (Intro to Electrical Engineering).

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented static code analyzer for the ACPI source language used in every Surface device.
• Detected incompatibilities between the Intel and Microsoft compilers to drive the ACPI industry towards an open source compiler.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
• Leading a team of 5 students to develop Density, a web application that estimates (live) how full different libraries and dining halls at Columbia are.
• Developing Machine Learning algorithms to estimate live population based on the number of devices connected to WiFi routers. Using data analytics, we can make future population predictions.
• Built using Python and PostgreSQL. Available at: https://github.com/ADI-Labs/density

positions.title: Internal Lead
positions.description:
• Lead of ADI - the largest technology student club on campus that organizes events, initiatives and workshops for a community of 1200 students interested in technology.
• Organize a yearly hackathon (DevFest) for 700 students, regular workshop series on software and hardware topics, a mentorship program, company and recruiting events, and numerous other initiatives related to computer science and technology.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Working with Professor Hod Lipson. Creating a low cost, open-source ultrasound imaging device
• Part of CS team: High frequency signal processing, 3D image creation and microcontroller (STM32) programming.
• Part of EE team: Designing, building and testing all the electronics and circuit schematics for the analog front-end.

company.name: Creative Machines Lab at Columbia University

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Worked in the first-party engineering team (SIGMA org). Joined battery team for a first-party Microsoft device in the Surface line.
• Developed a UWP app to display critical live data about the battery system.
• Worked on the battery driver for the Windows 10 image for this device. Circuit design and analysis for high frequency signals in the product’s hardware.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: • Worked in an open source compiler from TypeScript to WebAssembly and built a demo to demonstrate the performance gain of using WebAssembly.
